summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its acquisition of ARC Resources Ltd. Under terms, ARC shareholders receive CAD 8.20 cash and 0.40247 Shell shares per ARC share (~25% cash/75% stock), equating to CAD 32.80/share, a 20% premium to ARC's 30-day VWAP. Equity value is ~US$13.6B; enterprise value ~US$16.4B including ~US$2.8B net debt. Both boards unanimously recommend the deal, expected close H2 2026 subject to ARC shareholder and regulatory approvals. Watch for ARC shareholder vote and Canadian/regulatory clearance; risk-arb should monitor spread due to stock component and cross-border regulatory timeline.
